# P32W instruction reference

*Generated by `generators/gen_isaref.py` from `microcode/p32isa.py` — do not edit.* Encodings: [isa-v0.md](isa-v0.md); system instructions: [isa-system.md](isa-system.md); how to use them: [programmers-guide.md](programmers-guide.md).

Word: `OP[31:24] A[23:20] B[19:16] C[15:12] IMM16[15:0]` (or `OFF24[23:0]`). **P** = privileged (traps PRIVILEGE in user mode). Branch and jump offsets count words from PC + 4.

| Op | Mnemonic | Operands | Format | P | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `01` | **HALT** | `` | N | P | stop the machine (emulators: exit status = r1 & 0xFF) |
| `10` | **ADD** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = rs1 + rs2 |
| `11` | **SUB** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = rs1 − rs2 |
| `12` | **AND** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = rs1 & rs2 |
| `13` | **OR** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = rs1 \| rs2 |
| `14` | **XOR** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = rs1 ^ rs2 |
| `15` | **SLL** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = rs1 << (rs2 & 31) |
| `16` | **SRL** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = rs1 >> (rs2 & 31), zero fill |
| `17` | **SRA** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = rs1 >> (rs2 & 31), sign fill |
| `18` | **SLT** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = (rs1 < rs2) signed ? 1 : 0 |
| `19` | **SLTU** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = (rs1 < rs2) unsigned ? 1 : 0 |
| `1A` | **NOR** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = ~(rs1 \| rs2) |
| `20` | **ADDI** | `rd, rs1, simm16` | I |  | rd = rs1 + sext(imm) |
| `22` | **ANDI** | `rd, rs1, uimm16` | IU |  | rd = rs1 & zext(imm) |
| `23` | **ORI** | `rd, rs1, uimm16` | IU |  | rd = rs1 \| zext(imm) |
| `24` | **XORI** | `rd, rs1, uimm16` | IU |  | rd = rs1 ^ zext(imm) |
| `25` | **SLLI** | `rd, rs1, shamt` | SH |  | rd = rs1 << shamt |
| `26` | **SRLI** | `rd, rs1, shamt` | SH |  | rd = rs1 >> shamt, zero fill |
| `27` | **SRAI** | `rd, rs1, shamt` | SH |  | rd = rs1 >> shamt, sign fill |
| `28` | **SLTI** | `rd, rs1, simm16` | I |  | rd = (rs1 < sext(imm)) signed |
| `29` | **SLTIU** | `rd, rs1, simm16` | I |  | rd = (rs1 < sext(imm)) unsigned |
| `2F` | **LUI** | `rd, uimm16` | LUI |  | rd = imm << 16 |
| `30` | **MUL** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = low 32 bits of rs1 × rs2 |
| `31` | **MULH** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = high 32 bits, signed × signed |
| `32` | **MULHU** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = high 32 bits, unsigned × unsigned |
| `34` | **DIV** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = rs1 / rs2 signed, toward zero (÷0 → −1; 0x80000000/−1 → 0x80000000) |
| `35` | **DIVU** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = rs1 / rs2 unsigned (÷0 → 0xFFFFFFFF) |
| `36` | **REM** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = rs1 % rs2 signed, sign of rs1 (÷0 → rs1; 0x80000000 % −1 → 0) |
| `37` | **REMU** | `rd, rs1, rs2` | R |  | rd = rs1 % rs2 unsigned (÷0 → rs1) |
| `40` | **LB** | `rd, simm16(rs1)` | LD |  | rd = sext(byte at rs1 + imm) |
| `41` | **LH** | `rd, simm16(rs1)` | LD |  | rd = sext(halfword), aligned |
| `42` | **LW** | `rd, simm16(rs1)` | LD |  | rd = word, aligned |
| `44` | **LBU** | `rd, simm16(rs1)` | LD |  | rd = zext(byte) |
| `45` | **LHU** | `rd, simm16(rs1)` | LD |  | rd = zext(halfword), aligned |
| `48` | **SB** | `rs, simm16(rb)` | ST |  | byte at rb + imm = rs |
| `49` | **SH** | `rs, simm16(rb)` | ST |  | halfword = rs, aligned |
| `4A` | **SW** | `rs, simm16(rb)` | ST |  | word = rs, aligned |
| `4C` | **SWAP** | `rd, simm16(rs1)` | LD |  | exchange rd with the aligned word at rs1 + imm, atomically (D51) |
| `50` | **BEQ** | `ra, rb, label` | BR |  | if ra == rb: PC = PC + 4 + 4 × off |
| `51` | **BNE** | `ra, rb, label` | BR |  | if ra != rb |
| `54` | **BLT** | `ra, rb, label` | BR |  | if ra < rb signed |
| `55` | **BGE** | `ra, rb, label` | BR |  | if ra ≥ rb signed |
| `56` | **BLTU** | `ra, rb, label` | BR |  | if ra < rb unsigned |
| `57` | **BGEU** | `ra, rb, label` | BR |  | if ra ≥ rb unsigned |
| `60` | **JMP** | `label` | J |  | PC = PC + 4 + 4 × off24 |
| `61` | **CALL** | `label` | J |  | push PC + 4; PC = PC + 4 + 4 × off24 |
| `62` | **JR** | `rb` | JR |  | PC = rb (a multiple of 4) |
| `63` | **CALLR** | `rb` | JR |  | push PC + 4; PC = rb |
| `64` | **RET** | `` | N |  | PC = pop |
| `70` | **SYSCALL** | `` | N |  | trap SYSCALL (EPC = this instruction) |
| `71` | **RTE** | `` | N | P | PC = EPC; S = PS; IE = PIE |
| `72` | **MFCR** | `rd, cr  /  cr, rs` | CR | P | rd = control register cr |
| `73` | **MTCR** | `rd, cr  /  cr, rs` | CR | P | control register cr = rs |
| `74` | **BREAK** | `` | N |  | trap BREAK |
| `75` | **WAIT** | `` | N | P | idle until (IPEND & IMASK) ≠ 0 |
| `76` | **TLBW** | `` | N | P | write TLBHI / TLBLO into the TLB entry TLBHI selects |

## Control registers (MFCR / MTCR)

| # | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 | `STATUS` |
| 1 | `EPC` |
| 2 | `CAUSE` |
| 3 | `BADADDR` |
| 4 | `VBR` |
| 5 | `USP` |
| 6 | `IPEND` |
| 7 | `IMASK` |
| 8 | `ASID` |
| 9 | `TLBHI` |
| 10 | `TLBLO` |

## Exception causes (CAUSE)

| Code | Name |
|---|---|
| 1 | ILLEGAL |
| 2 | PRIVILEGE |
| 3 | MISALIGNED |
| 4 | BUSERROR |
| 5 | SYSCALL |
| 6 | BREAK |
| 8 | TLBMISS_X |
| 9 | TLBMISS_R |
| 10 | TLBMISS_W |
| 11 | PROTECT |
| 0x8000_0000 + n | interrupt on IRQn |
